comments.body: I don't think this can be obtained with any Appraisal map, unless someone can prove me wrong. This can be gotten from a "Cargo ship of the Northeast passage" SW located in the Northeast passage that can spawn anywhere from the Laptev Sea eastward to the Sea of Okhotsk.
